rationale: v1.80.1 already has device/room creation forms, room-settings saves and the wall-chain finalizer. This protects unfinished input and exits from existing refused workflows; it is not polish of functionality first introduced in the current beta cycle.

summary.ru: Редактор сохраняет незавершённый ввод при отказе сохранения и позволяет выйти из ошибочной цепочки, не удаляя стены.
summary.en: The editor preserves unfinished input after a refused save and lets you leave a failed wall chain without deleting walls.
